summary: SiteDocuments is a web user control managing site-level documents, including upload, edit, delete, sorting, discipline filtering, and destination assignment with extensive UI and business logic for documents and their associated disciplines/destinations.
purpose: Provide a user interface and backend logic for managing documents associated with a site, including uploading documents, filtering by type and discipline, assigning destinations, and handling business rules related to discipline and destination selection. Supports dynamic add/edit/delete operations, validation, workflow for document creation, and discipline/destination assignment.
actors: Web UI Controls (FormView, GridView, DropDownList, ListBox, etc.)

workflows.name: Document Management Workflow
steps: User accesses SiteDocuments control with editable permissions.
User can add a new document (HandleAdd).
On adding/editing (fvwDocument_DataBound), setup discipline filters, type selection, upload note.
If inserting/editing, show upload panel, allow type/disciplines selection, handle validations.
On 'cmdSave', uploaded file is handled, saved to unique folder, meta fields set (HandleUploadedFile, SaveDocument).
Discipline assignment: Allow all or select specific disciplines via list box/radio button logic (SetupDisciplines, AllowAll_SelectedIndexChanged).
Destination assignment: ListBox controls allow moving destinations between included/not included, reflecting document's allowed destinations (SetupDestinations).
After save, UI refreshes, user session cache updated, optionally redirects to current page.
Editing/deleting documents handled via grid row commands.
Document types and discipline filters dynamically populated and validated.

workflows.name: Destination Assignment Workflow
steps: User edits or adds applied children (documents).
SetupDestinations loads possible destination codes from backend.
List boxes show included and not-included destinations.
User moves destinations using AddRight_Click, AddLeft_Click, AddAll_Click, RemoveAll_Click.
Selected destinations are saved and assigned via backend call when document is saved.

business_rules: Documents must be associated with a ParentID (e.g., SiteID).
TypeCodes can be omitted based on configuration (OmitTypeCodes).
Disciplines can be restricted (RestrictedSubDisciplines) and filtered by user/session.
Subdisciplines can be applied to documents, either all or selected.
Destination assignment requires selecting from allowed list; no destinations, means all allowed.
Document file uploads are saved in unique folders, must have valid file type and size.
If no discipline is selected, all disciplines are automatically applied and a warning is shown.
validations: Required fields on document type, name, discipline (if UseSubDisciplines).
File upload must be present and valid.
UserSession must be active for document management.
DropDownList and ListBox values must be correctly populated and selected.
If UserSession is null, ObjectDataSource selection is cancelled.
calculations: Section assignment and grouping logic in GridView row processing.
Dynamic sorting of documents by field as per ViewState["Sort"]
Dynamic discipline list creation and filtering based on document and session.
conditions: UseSubDisciplines toggles discipline UI and filtering logic.
RestrictedSubDisciplines controls discipline filtering and visibility for user.
If inserting a document and no discipline selected, auto-apply all disciplines.
system_behavior: Auto-generated fields in partial class for UI controls.
Dynamic binding and refresh of data sources for disciplines, documents, destinations.
UI visibility toggles based on user/session state and editing mode.
Cache user session after data modification.
Redirect on document change for UI feedback.
dependencies: Disciplines methods for searching and filtering discipline/subdiscipline lists.
Grid utility methods for UI and value management.

If discipline list is empty, forces all disciplines and warns user.
